name: spline
title: Spline
description: A dark two-column banner with a headline and paragraph on the left and a real-time 3D robot on the right. The robot rotates and shifts its pose as the pointer moves across the canvas.
use: A landing hero or feature banner where a 3D mascot or product model should react to the visitor's pointer.
avoid: Needs a separate 3D runtime plus a remote scene URL, so it is heavy to load and breaks offline.
a11y: The canvas has no accessible name or fallback text, and the pointer tracking has no keyboard or reduced-motion alternative. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide black banner split in two: white headline and grey paragraph on the left, a glossy black-and-white humanoid robot on the right. The robot has a smooth rounded helmet head, a chest with fine mesh texture and articulated arms, lit from above against the dark.
behaves: The 3D robot turns, tilts and shifts nearer or farther as the pointer moves across the canvas, giving the impression it is watching the cursor. While the scene downloads, a loading message sits in its place.
customise: Pass a scene URL, an onLoad callback, renderOnDemand and className/style; the loading placeholder is whatever children you give it. The 3D content itself lives in the scene file.
weight: heavy: Runs a full WebGL 3D scene through a separate runtime loaded from a remote file.
